name: application_fault
description: The fake backend refuses the torque write, the runtime latches WriteFailed during its startup path and keeps running, and the real application reports behavior=Fault with the lower runtime=Fault - it never sends a target and never claims a stop. The runtime then refuses to leave the latched fault on SIGTERM, and the application, whose ordered exit can no longer be confirmed, reports stop=unknown lower=Fault with exit code 3. The emergency stop on a healthy link (upper Fault with the lower layer keeping its own Damping output) is asserted by application_repeat_and_reset, and the Reset that clears a latched lower fault is deliberately NOT asserted here: the real two-process acceptance found that the application does not reach Standby on the Reset the runtime applies (see the note in docs/testing.md), so this scenario does not encode either behaviour.

steps.note: the runtime's own recovery window opens although the latch stays
